# W35 Read-only DOV bridge and source-bound rollup

**Canonical global SSOT:** [W38 global dashboard](../../../MIP/EVIDENCE_TO_ADMISSION_OBSERVATORY/global/index.html), generated by `render_global.py` from W38 `ledger.json`. W35 is an additive exploration/refresh projection, **not a second global data authority**.

## Files

- `mission_control_w35.html`: standalone, no external JS/CSS, read-only GitHub GET refresh; no authenticated operations. Static bootstrap is historical.
- `w35_ledger.json`: dated, non-atomic, source-bound fixture for offline import and local rollup; actual production truth stays in GitHub and canonical issue/receipts.
- `w35_rollup.json`: locally derived read-only view; not native proof.
- `../../../../tools/recovery/w35_census_rollup.py`: pure-python provenance-aware rollup, coverage comparator and DMAIC queue/plateau guard.
- `../../../../tests/test_w35_census_rollup.py`: 38 local adversarial and regression tests.
- `W35_GROWTH_HANDOVER.md`: multi-lane owner, root, DOV and N−1/N/N+1 action plan.

## Local reproducibility (not native acceptance)

```sh
python -m pytest -q tests/test_w35_census_rollup.py
python tools/recovery/w35_census_rollup.py --input tools/everred_v3/dashboard/w35_ledger.json --output w35_rollup.json
```

Generated data values must never be used to authorize a merge, dispatch, waiver, GitHub admin settings change or QPS owner acceptance. An unverified origin cannot produce an authenticated proof receipt. API failures and missing numerator/denominator remain `null`/`UNKNOWN`.

## Reload order

Read W38 canonical ledger, resolve current main and #1860, open W35 HTML, use `Refresh ABACUS` and `Refresh five repos`, optionally import a `codepurple.w35.dashboard-ledger.v1` fixture for untrusted exploratory review. UI browser observation export is never automatically promoted to the governed ledger.
